signal_text: Gumroad's Terms of Service (effective January 1, 2025) states that regardless of listed currency, all transactions settle in USD, with exchange rates sourced from openexchangerates.org and the rate accuracy not guaranteed.
subject_exact: Gumroad USD settlement policy for multi-currency transactions with exchange rate determination
local_qualifiers: Regardless of listed currency, all transactions through the Services will settle in USD
extraction_notes: Settlement currency is always USD regardless of listed price currency. Exchange rate source identified as openexchangerates.org. Rate accuracy not guaranteed.
